title: Red Chain Punk Girl
description: Three sequential poses of the same female character with long black and red hair, wearing a red and black punk outfit with chains, corset, short jagged skirt, and heavy boots. The left image shows a fighting stance with fists raised, the middle a dynamic running pose with arms outstretched, and the right a forward-moving action stance.
prompt: A female character with long flowing black hair with red streaks and bangs, wearing a red sleeveless top, black corset, short jagged red skirt, red arm warmers, and heavy black lace-up boots with chains attached. She has a fierce expression with red eyes. Shown in three different dynamic action poses against a plain gray background: combat stance with fists up, running forward with arms out, and aggressive forward motion. Digital painting style with strong lighting and fabric details.
